review_candidates.title: Lawyer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Law Firm & Legal Consultations Office is a professional legal services provider based in Cairo, serving a diverse range of individual and corporate clients. The firm focuses on delivering practical legal solutions, clear advice, and effective representation across multiple practice areas. Team members collaborate to handle complex matters, support clients through disputes, and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. The work environment values integrity, confidentiality, and continuous professional development, offering opportunities to build long-term client relationships and grow within the legal field. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Lawyer role located in Cairo. The Lawyer will draft, review, and negotiate contracts, legal opinions, and other documents, ensuring accuracy and adherence to relevant laws. The role includes representing clients before courts and administrative authorities, preparing case files, and managing litigation timelines. The Lawyer will conduct legal research, analyze regulations, and advise clients on risk, compliance, and dispute resolution strategies. Daily responsibilities also involve coordinating with colleagues, maintaining detailed case records, and communicating complex legal concepts in a clear, accessible manner. Qualifications Strong legal research and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret statutes, regulations, and case law. Experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating legal documents such as contracts, agreements, and memoranda. Competence in litigation and dispute resolution, including case preparation, court representation, and client advocacy. Effective communication and client-facing skills, including clear written expression and professional oral presentation. High level of organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines. Bachelor’s degree in Law (LL.B or equivalent) from an accredited institution; membership in the local bar association in Egypt is preferred. Knowledge of Egyptian law and procedures; familiarity with corporate, civil, or commercial law is an advantage. Proficiency in relevant legal software and standard office applications; ability to maintain confidential records securely. Commitment to ethical practice, continuous learning, and collaboration within a multidisciplinary legal team.

Relevant academic background in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. Experience with recruitment processes, interviewing coordination, and basic HR reporting is beneficial.

review_candidates.title: Production Lines Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description ECB is a fast-growing engineering and consultancy firm established in 1997, with a multidisciplinary platform serving diverse sectors. The company combines deep knowledge of Egypt’s market with international exposure to deliver client-oriented solutions. ECB is recognized for its strong track record in design, site supervision, and project management. Its management system meets ISO 9001:2015 requirements, reflecting a commitment to quality and continuous improvement. Team members benefit from a professional environment focused on technical excellence and sustainable growth. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Production Lines Sales Engineer role based in Cairo, Egypt. The Production Lines Sales Engineer will identify and pursue sales opportunities for production line solutions, prepare technical and commercial proposals, and conduct product demonstrations and presentations to prospective clients. The role involves understanding customer requirements, coordinating with engineering teams to develop tailored solutions, and providing ongoing technical support before and after sales. The engineer will manage client accounts, follow up on inquiries, negotiate contracts within company guidelines, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. Daily tasks also include maintaining accurate sales documentation, tracking market trends, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to achieve sales targets. Qualifications Strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills, with the ability to translate technical features into business value. Proficiency in Sales and Customer Service, including lead generation, account management, and relationship building. Excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal, for engaging with clients and internal teams. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, or related field) or an equivalent technical discipline. Experience with production lines, industrial equipment, or manufacturing environments is highly beneficial. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications, and work collaboratively with design and project teams. Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on meeting client needs and achieving sales goals. Proficiency in MS Office and relevant CRM tools; fluency in English and Arabic is an advantage.
